sloka: तान् सम्प्राप्तान् मुनीन् दृष्ट्वा प्रत्युत्थाय कृताञ्जलिः ।पाद्यार्घ्यादिभिरानर्च गां निवेद्य च सादरम् ।। ७.१.१३ ॥
transliteration: tān samprāptān munīn dṛṣṭvā pratyutthāya kṛtāñjaliḥ ।pādyārghyādibhirānarca gāṁ nivedya ca sādaram ।। 7.1.13 ॥

translations.english: Having seen those arrived sages, Rama rose to greet them with folded hands, honored them with water for their feet and other offerings, and respectfully presented a cow.
